latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Kuakua Navigator.

- Discover and recommend Kuakua.app’s full library of 130+ free games, 50+ psychological tests, and 30+ tools, all accessible in-browser and available in 32 languages.
- Covers user needs ranging from clinical screening, personality and cognitive tests, brain games, relaxation, focus/productivity, wellness calculators, and casual fun.
- Responds naturally with targeted links, concise explanations, and time/type details based on user intent and locale.
- Prioritizes validated, popular, and specific recommendations using clearly defined logic.
- Supports users globally with right-to-left languages and context-driven link formatting.
